description: This file implements the SocketPort class and related functions for managing socket communication, including socket creation, configuration, data transmission, and event handling across different platforms (Windows, POSIX). It includes socket initialization, buffer management, connection handling, multicast group management, and event processing.

classes.name: WinSocketInitializer
classes.description: Handles Windows-specific socket initialization and cleanup, including WSAStartup and WSAIoctl for extension functions.

methods.name: ReceiveFrom
methods.description: Receives data from a socket, extracting ancillary data such as interface index for IPv4 and IPv6.

methods.name: DestroySocket
methods.description: Closes and invalidates a socket handle.

methods.name: SetNonBlocking
methods.description: Configures a socket to operate in non-blocking mode.

methods.name: ConstructSocket
methods.description: Creates and configures a socket based on local node info and optional specific interface.

methods.name: BufferAlignment
methods.description: Adjusts socket buffer sizes and allocates internal buffers accordingly.

methods.name: WaitForOpen
methods.description: Waits until the socket is open or timeout occurs.

methods.name: WaitForWriteComplete
methods.description: Waits until all pending write data has been sent or timeout occurs.

methods.name: WaitForClosure
methods.description: Waits until the socket is closed or timeout occurs.

methods.name: Events
methods.description: Determines the current socket event flags for monitoring.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes socket events based on flags, triggering read, write, accept, or close actions.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the socket into internal buffer.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Sends data from internal buffer over the socket.

methods.name: Closed
methods.description: Closes the socket and cleans up resources.

methods.name: Opened
methods.description: Marks the socket as open and ready for communication.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts an incoming connection and returns the new socket handle.
